text.text:
*🔧 Connect Your Own Assistant to Nancy Brain*

Use the existing hosted microlensing knowledge base. Run `/mcp_api_key` here to receive your personal key, then connect your MCP client to:

`https://mcp.rges-pit.com/mcp`

Nancy accepts the key as `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer`. Client-specific setup for Codex, VS Code, Claude Code, and other clients is at <https://nancy.rges-pit.com/|nancy.rges-pit.com>.

Want to build a different knowledge base instead? See the <https://nancy-docs.malpas.nz/|Nancy Brain package documentation>.

*🛰️ Commissioning*

Nancy can relay automated Nexus commissioning alerts into the private commissioning channel. Threshold evaluation and duplicate suppression remain on Nexus; Nancy handles authenticated Slack delivery and links back to the dashboard.

*🚀 Quick Commands*

• `/mcp_api_key` - Get your Nancy Brain MCP API key
• `/my_quota` - Check your daily model usage
• `@nancy help` - Get general RGES-PIT assistance
• 🍳 *Keep Cooking* - Continue a deeper analysis
• Just ask naturally—I’ll search the curated knowledge base automatically
